title: Smooth integrability of diffeomorphisms
summary: Motivated by the notion of integrability introduced by Bogoyavlenskij for vector fields, we propose a definition of smooth integrability for general diffeomorphisms. In brief, we say that a diffeomorphism is integrable if it commutes with the flows of {\color{black}commutative} vector fields and shares their first integrals.
